content.short: Collab.Land is an NFT token gating bot for Telegram/Discord with over 6.5M verified wallets.
content.description: Collab.Land is a standardized bot for community management and engagement that can be added to Telegram or Discord. It gates membership based on token ownership, granting access only to current token holders and automatically revoking access when a holder sells their tokens. By tracking on-chain ownership, it helps communities manage gated channels and roles, keeping membership aligned with token ownership and reducing unauthorized access.
